user.title: Tesy convector
user.description: Usually you don't need this form: convectors on your network are discovered by themselves. To add one by hand, enter its IP address (the router's client list shows it).

data_description.ip_address: Used for local control. If the address changes later, Home Assistant picks up the new one when it sees the convector again.
data_description.temperature_entity: The convector doesn't report the room temperature. Pick a sensor in the same room to show it on the thermostat card.

discovery_confirm.title: Tesy convector found
discovery_confirm.description: A Tesy convector answered at {host}. Add it? Control is local: no account or internet needed.

data_description.temperature_entity: The convector doesn't report the room temperature. Pick a sensor in the same room to show it on the thermostat card.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from a convector at this address.
error.unsupported: The device answered, but not like a supported Tesy convector (older Tesy units use a different API).

abort.already_configured: This convector is already set up.

init.title: Tesy convector settings
init.description: Everything here is optional. Device MAC: {mac}.

data_description.temperature_entity: Shown as the current temperature on the thermostat card.
data_description.cloud_email: Adds what the local API lacks: Heating on/off and the convector's own temperature. Read-only (nothing is sent to the cloud). Use the account the convector is registered to. Clear to remove.
data_description.cloud_password: Stays in Home Assistant. Leave blank to keep the saved one, or to reuse the one saved for the same email on another convector.
data_description.ip_address: Only if the convector moved and wasn't rediscovered.

cloud_device.title: Which device is this convector?
cloud_device.description: This convector (MAC {mac}) wasn't found automatically among the {count} device(s) on the account. Pick it, or — for none.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from a convector at this address.
error.unsupported: The device answered, but not like a supported Tesy convector (older Tesy units use a different API).
error.invalid_auth: MyTESY rejected the email or password.
